scope: Matched compute, buffer and HBM settings. Generic service mapping is a modeled proxy, not a GPU timing run.
utilization: The 51.83% and 86.83% representative Slice utilization values are transferred to sparse issue stages; they are not measured trajectory averages.
generic_cost: Plane formation is charged as one vector operation per value in a 512-value Slice. Multicast is charged as one vector unit per BF16 value. Prefetch and compute are serial on the generic path.
